traits.name: Creature Sense
traits.desc: The brain breaker is aware of creatures within 1 mile of itself that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each one's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a [[Tools/Spells/Mind Blank|mind blank]] spell, a [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]] spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The brain breaker has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Telepathic Hub
traits.desc: The brain breaker can use its telepathy to initiate and maintain telepathic conversations with up to ten creatures at a time. The brain breaker can let those creatures telepathically hear each other while connected in this way.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The brain breaker makes two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. The brain breaker can have up to four targets grappled at a time.

actions.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Creatures of the brain breaker's choice within 60 feet of itself must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or take 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. Until the link ends, the brain breaker can perceive everything the target senses. The target becomes aware that something is linked to its mind once it no longer has the incapacitated condition, and the brain breaker can terminate the link at any time (no action required). The target can use an action on its turn to attempt to break the link, doing so with a successful DC 17 Charisma check. If the target breaks the link this way, the target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The link also ends if the target and the brain breaker are more than 1 mile apart. The brain breaker can form psychic links with up to ten creatures at a time.

traits.name: Petrifying Gaze

If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]] spell or other magic. If the creature does so, it can't see Honna until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Honna in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If Honna sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of it and in an area of bright light, Honna is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d6) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the start of Ontharyx's next turn.

reactions.name: Defensive Flight
reactions.desc: Immediately after taking damage, Ontharyx flies up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

sb.name: Oshundo the Alhoon
sb.languages: Common, Deep Speech, telepathy 120 ft., Undercommon

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Oshundo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Oshundo makes two Chilling Grasp or Arcane Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Chilling Grasp
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) cold damage, and Oshundo regains 14 hit points if the target is a creature.

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (8d6) force damage.

actions.name: Thundering Blast (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Oshundo emits a wave of domineering energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 22 (4d8 + 4) thunder damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Oshundo casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|disguise self]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Monster|dominate monster]], [[Tools/Spells/Globe Of Invulnerability|globe of invulnerability]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Modify Memory|modify memory]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|wall of force]]

reactions.name: Negate Spell (3/Day)
reactions.desc: Oshundo targets one creature it can perceive within 60 feet of itself that is casting a spell. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, the spell fails, but any spell slots or charges aren't wasted.

traits.name: Virulent Breath
traits.desc: Noxious gas from the mutate's digestion of previous meals spews from its mouth. At the start of the mutate's turn, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mutate makes two Bite or Tentacle attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Chitin Slam.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. On a successful save, the target is no longer poisoned. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until it no longer has the poisoned condition.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 15) and the restrained condition until this grapple ends. The mutate has two tentacles that can grapple one target each.

actions.name: Chitin Slam
actions.desc: The mutate targets one creature it is grappling, slamming the creature against its chitinous plating. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage and have the stunned condition until the end of the mutate's next turn.

sb.name: Psionic Ashenwight
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, unconscious
sb.languages: telepathy 120 ft., understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ashenwight makes two Necrotic Shard attacks. It also uses Psionic Crown if available.

actions.name: Necrotic Shard
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Psionic Crown (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The ashenwight wreathes the head of a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself with a crown of jagged, spectral crystals. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, the target's thoughts are sluggish; it can't take reactions, its speed is halved, and it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.desc:
The ashenwight casts one of the following spells, requiring no spellcasting components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]] (the hand is invisible)
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Calm Emotions|calm emotions]]

sb.name: Psionic Shambling Mound
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.desc:
The shambling mound casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 8):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]] (already cast)

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Qunbraxel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Qunbraxel makes two Eldritch Bolt attacks, or one Eldritch Bolt attack and one Tentacle attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 16) and must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Eldritch Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Extract Brain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Humanoid with the stunned condition who is grappled by Qunbraxel. Hit: 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Qunbraxel kills it by extracting and devouring its brain.

actions.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Qunbraxel magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 26 (5d8 + 4) psychic damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.desc:
Qunbraxel casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|levitate]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]] (the hand is invisible), [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Confusion|confusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|sending]], [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|telekinesis]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Monster|dominate monster]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]] (self only)

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Refraction of Ilvaash
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
sb.languages: Common, Deep Speech, telepathy 100 miles, Undercommon

traits.name: Creature Sense
traits.desc: The refraction is aware of creatures within 100 miles of it that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each one's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a [[Tools/Spells/Mind Blank|mind blank]] spell, a [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]] spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The refraction can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.desc: If the refraction fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The refraction has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The refraction makes two Dissonant Claw attacks.

actions.name: Dissonant Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) psychic damage. If the target is a creature concentrating on a spell, its concentration is broken.

actions.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Creatures of the refraction's choice within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or take 33 (5d10 + 6) psychic damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The refraction teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied place that it can see.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.desc:
The refraction casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Modify Memory|modify memory]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Feeblemind|feeblemind]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]] (self only)

legendary_actions.name: Mindbreaker
legendary_actions.desc: The refraction targets a creature within 120 feet of itself and disrupts its mental processes, causing the target to have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of the target's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Projected Claw (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The refraction makes one Dissonant Claw attack.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.desc: Rivibiddel has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.desc: Rivibiddel has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Rivibiddel's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]] (self only)
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Blindness/Deafness|blindness/deafness]], [[Tools/Spells/Blur|blur]], [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|disguise self]]

actions.name: War Pick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Poisoned Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: When Ruxithid fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Mental Fortitude
traits.desc: Ruxithid has advantage on saving throws against the charmed and frightened conditions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ruxithid makes two Psi-Charged Scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Psi-Charged Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Brain Tendrils (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Ruxithid unleashes a flurry of crystalline psychic tendrils from his brain, targeting one creature that he can see within 30 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) psychic damage and have the stunned condition until the start of Ruxithid's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Combat Command
bonus_actions.desc: Ruxithid commands one allied creature he can see within 60 feet of himself to strike. The creature can immediately use its reaction to make one melee weapon attack against a target within its reach.

sb.name: Shalfi Lewin
sb.senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 10 ft., passive Perception 15

traits.name: Aberrant Form
traits.desc: Shalfi exudes the chaos of the Far Realm. Any non-Aberration creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of Shalfi must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

traits.name: Weirdly Pliable
traits.desc: Shalfi, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, is unnaturally flexible. Shalfi can move through any space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Shalfi makes one Psychic Rend attack and two Shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Rend
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of Shalfi's next turn.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.desc:
Shalfi casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Arcane Gate|arcane gate]], [[Tools/Spells/Hunger Of Hadar|hunger of Hadar]]

bonus_actions.name: Void Warp (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Shalfi teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet of itself, leaving a churning void in the space it left. Immediately after it teleports, each creature within 30 feet of the void other than Shalfi must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) force damage and is pulled to the unoccupied space closest to the void. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. The void then disappears.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Sildar makes two Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: When an attacker Sildar can see would hit him with a melee attack, he can roll a d6 and add the number rolled to his AC against the triggering attack, provided he's wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
traits.desc:
Varakkta's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]] (the hand is invisible)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Jump|jump]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]], [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Tongues|tongues]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]], [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|telekinesis]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Varakkta makes two silver greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Silver Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. This is a magic weapon attack. On a critical hit against a target in an astral body (as with the [[Tools/Spells/Astral Projection|astral projection]] spell), Varakkta can cut the silvery cord that tethers the target to its material body, instead of dealing damage.

sb.name: Voalsh
sb.senses: darkvision 120 ft., truesight 15 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Voalsh fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Voalsh has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Voalsh makes two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) psychic damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 17) and must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or have the incapacitated condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Extract Brain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid grappled by Voalsh. Hit: 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Voalsh kills it by extracting and devouring its brain.

actions.name: Unleash Void (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Voalsh opens a rift into the Far Realm, centered on a point Voalsh can see within 60 feet of itself, and a tentacle lashes across creatures near the rift. Each creature other than mind flayers within 30 feet of the rift must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw, after which the tentacle disappears and the rift closes. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) cold damage from the rift plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage from the tentacle and has the stunned condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.desc:
Voalsh casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]] (the hand is invisible)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Clairvoyance|clairvoyance]] (as an action), [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]] (self only)

reactions.name: Warp Reality
reactions.desc: When hit by an attack roll, Voalsh gains a +4 bonus to its AC against that attack roll, potentially causing it to miss. Then Voalsh, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, magically teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Yanthdel has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Yanthdel to sleep.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, Yanthdel has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Yanthdel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|levitate]] (self only)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Yanthdel makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Yanthdel adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Yanthdel must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

sb.name: Zeond
sb.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Zeond can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a bat (speed 10 ft. fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., swim 40 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Zeond has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claw (Bite in Beast Form)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Scare (1/Day)
actions.desc: One creature of Zeond's choice within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if Zeond is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: Zeond magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Scare, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment Zeond wears or carries is invisible with it.
